reuse.why: The detach step copies the field-clearing update from unlinkAccount instead of extracting and sharing that reset (e.g. a local-only unlink helper used by both).

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so 'what unlinked means' now lives in two places.

placement.why: A function named assertBankAccountNotLinked now mutates other accounts, mixing a guard with a side-effecting takeover step, and adds a redundant target-existence check.

scope.why: Changes are limited to threading the flag through the six link handlers, the guard and a release note.

maintainability.why: A misleadingly named assert with side effects plus a copied unlink reset that can drift from unlinkAccount would be uncomfortable to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked: re-implements the account reset of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it (without the provider call)

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink field reset in assertBankAccountNotLinked is a plain verbatim copy, not disguised
